title.rendered: Smimo 120 Depackager – Organic Food Waste Processing

content.rendered: Riley Casey, Southwest Sales Manager for Van Dyk Recycling Solutions, explains the unique features and benefits of the Smimo 120 depackaging machine at Waste Expo 2023. The Smimo 120 separates a wide variety of food from its packaging, resulting in streams of high-quality organic matter free of contamination, and empty, recyclable packaging. Read more about the capabilities of Smimo machines here.
